commit.subject: telemetry: keep Claude gaps outside waste rankings
commit.body:
Use the documented Claude path encoding for unreadable candidates and
report them as unassigned gaps after the measured ranking cap. Derive
turns and average context from validated last-wins usage, and require
error evidence before a deny marker counts as a refusal.
